items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: John Mason and Johnny Vaggard(?) was two comedians. They did the comedy work.

ctx.x: Yeah, they had dancers and singers, and then two comedians... John Mason and Johnny Vaggard(?) was two comedians. They did the comedy work. I can't think of this boy's name -- him and this girl did the dancing. Then they had two or three other little acts.
